name: Miller Scales & Food Machines
old_description: Miller Scales & Food Machines has provided goods and services to the butcher and meat processing industry since 1960. We have a proven track record for quality service and competitive sales offerings. Whether you are in need of seasonings, packing supplies, or food equipment, we are here to assist.
about:
Miller Scales & Food Machines has operated from Fort Wayne, Indiana since 1960. The company began as a supplier to the butcher and meat processing trade, though the founding family or individuals are not identified in public records.

The business combines product distribution with hands-on technical support. Its product line includes seasonings, packaging supplies, and food-processing equipment from brands such as Biro, Ishida, Rice Lake Weighing Systems, and Kentmaster. A fully staffed service department performs on-site and in-house repairs, grinder-plate and knife sharpening, scale programming, and custom seasoning blending. A route-truck program delivers supplies to customers in the region.

Customers are primarily butcher shops, meat processors, and related food-service operations. The company maintains memberships in the American Association of Meat Processors, the Indiana Meat Packers and Processors Association, the Michigan Meat Association, and the Ohio Association of Meat Processors, indicating a focus on the Midwest and Great Lakes meat trade.

The company emphasizes its long-standing reputation for quality service and competitive pricing as its differentiator.

name: Minneapolis Sheet Metal Works
old_description: Minneapolis Sheet Metal Works was founded over a century ago in the heart of downtown Minneapolis. Our roots stem from working with the booming commodity industry by designing unique dust collection solutions for grain elevators and mills.
about:
Minneapolis Sheet Metal Works was founded in 1908 in downtown Minneapolis, Minnesota, and now operates from New Brighton. The company traces its roots to the region's booming commodity trade, where it designed custom dust-collection systems for grain elevators and mills.

Today the shop provides custom metal fabrication and machining, producing large and small components, assemblies, and structures. Its core processes include bending, forming, welding, and assembly of sheet, tube plate, round, bar, and angle stock. The facility works with stainless steel, brass, mild steel, galvanized metal, aluminum, and copper, and maintains unique dies for items such as street-light posts and spiral-chute flighting.

The company serves customers in paper manufacturing, industrial storage, agriculture, and environmental control. Documented projects include a custom safety guard for International Paper, stainless-steel hoppers for ferrite storage at Tundra Companies, discharge downspouts for an auto-glide conveyor at Dakota Growers, and a high-temperature heat exchanger for Environmental Control Solutions, Inc.

The firm emphasizes its 100-plus years of experience and a partnership approach, stating it is committed to delivering projects on time and to full customer satisfaction. Its founding mission — solving dust-collection challenges for the grain industry — remains a reference point for its problem-solving orientation.

name: Mission Furniture Manufacturing.
old_description: Mission Upholstery has been manufacturing quality custom upholstered furniture by skilled craftspeople since 1971.   We offer a selection of handcrafted custom styles or we can fabricate your own concept.
about:
Mission Furniture Manufacturing operates from a factory showroom in Los Angeles, California. The company was founded in 1971 by Cecilio Acevedo and remains a family-owned business, originally focusing on upholstery before expanding into broader furniture lines.

The firm manufactures custom upholstered furniture on site, building frames exclusively from solid wood without MDF, plywood, or particle board. It uses high-grade fabrics and high-density foam rubber for cushions. Services include custom upholstery, re-upholstery, furniture repairs, cushion re-stuffing and replacement, dining chair upholstery and repair, and custom mattress set fabrication. The company also offers free local delivery, in-home estimates, and no-credit-check financing.

Mission primarily serves residential customers seeking made-to-order furniture and restoration of existing pieces. Clients can submit photos for quotes on new builds or renewals, with nearly endless options for fabrics, dimensions, and firmness.

The company emphasizes that its family atmosphere sustains a tradition of quality and service, and that in-house production allows prices 40–70% below competitors. It avoids composite wood products and stresses full customization: "When we say custom, we mean custom."

name: Mission Solar Energy
old_description: Mission Solar Energy is an American solar panel manufacturer based in Texas. Produces commercial and industrial solar modules (panels) in its San Antonio facility, along with inverters and mounting systems.
about:
Mission Solar Energy operates from San Antonio, Texas, where it was founded in 2014 as a subsidiary of OCI Holdings, a South Korean green-energy and chemical conglomerate. The company was established to produce American-made solar modules and support domestic energy independence.

The company manufactures high-efficiency solar modules using N-type TOPCon cell technology, including monofacial 108-half-cell panels for rooftops and bifacial 144-half-cell dual-glass modules rated up to 590 W for commercial and industrial projects. It also produces string inverters and photovoltaic mounting systems. Production takes place at its San Antonio facility with a workforce of 200–499 employees, where modules undergo quality testing described as three times stricter than industry standards.

Mission Solar serves residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale markets across the United States. Its customers include solar installers, EPC contractors, project developers, and distributors, as well as homeowners who connect with local providers through the company’s network.

The company differentiates itself through a fully UFLPA-compliant supply chain, domestic manufacturing that enables faster delivery, hail-tested durability, and a 25-year power and product warranty. Its ethical sourcing policies and status as a U.S.-based manufacturer are cited as core reasons for its founding.

name: Mister Bee Potato Chips Co
old_description: Since 1951 Mister Bee has been making the finest potato chips from simple ingredients right here in the Mountain State. Our potato chips are made from real whole fresh potatoes. We pick our potatoes based on flavor not looks so no two chips are exactly alike. We leave the skins on and cook them lower and slower than the big chip companies because perfection takes time. The result is a true blast from the past.
about:
Mister Bee Potato Chips Co. has operated from Parkersburg, West Virginia, since its founding in 1951. The company began as a regional snack maker focused on producing potato chips from whole fresh potatoes, though the names of its original founders are not publicly documented.

The company manufactures kettle-style potato chips using a low-and-slow cooking method that leaves the potato skins on. Potatoes are selected for flavor rather than appearance, resulting in chips that vary in shape and color. The process emphasizes simple ingredients and a slower fry time compared to large-scale commercial producers.

Mister Bee serves the snack food market, distributing its chips through retail and wholesale channels. The brand positions itself as a heritage snack made in the Mountain State, appealing to consumers seeking a traditional potato chip experience.

The company differentiates itself by cooking chips at lower temperatures for longer periods, a practice it says preserves flavor and texture. Its marketing highlights the use of whole potatoes with skins intact and a selection process based on taste rather than visual uniformity.

name: Mitchell Electronics, Inc
old_description: Since 1979 Mitchell Electronics, Inc. has been serving the motion control industry. For over two decades we have been providing encoder and servo motor test equipment for use in the field of repair and plant maintenance. We continue to respond to market needs for innovative products that include rapid and comprehensive support and training.
about:
Mitchell Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1979 in Athens, Ohio. The company has served the motion control industry for over four decades, initially providing encoder and servo motor test equipment for repair and plant maintenance.

The company designs and manufactures a line of servo motor and feedback test equipment, including the TI-5000JX feedback tester, the TI-3000JX run tester, and the TI-5106 hardware adapter module for Hiperface DSL encoders. Its products are used for encoder diagnosis, alignment, memory reporting, and programming, as well as servo motor run testing and repair. Mitchell Electronics also provides the Athena Windows PC software application and the Bobcat online servo motor information database, and offers personalized training and support services.

Mitchell Electronics serves manufacturing operations, machine shops, electric motor repair shops, and motor and encoder production facilities. Its customers include paper manufacturers, automotive plants, food and beverage processors, and independent servo motor repair shops across 30 countries. The company reports supporting 180 motor manufacturers and maintaining a catalog of 300 motor cables.

The company emphasizes rapid, comprehensive support and training as a core differentiator, aiming to simplify maintenance of servo-driven automated equipment such as CNC machines and robots. It continuously adds support for new encoder protocols—including Fanuc Alpha i, SICK Stegmann Hiperface DSL, Heidenhain EnDat, BiSS, and Mitsubishi HG—while maintaining compatibility with legacy systems.

name: Mockingbird Food Group
old_description: At Mockingbird Food Group, we stand at the forefront of culinary excellence, driven by a passion for food and a commitment to unparalleled quality and safety. Founded by industry veterans and nestled within a vast network of related food companies, we bring decades of collective expertise to the table.
about:
Mockingbird Food Group is a co-packing operation based in Dallas, Texas, that began in 2019 as part of the Herr Heritage Fund family of companies. The business was started by food-industry veterans with nearly 50 years of combined experience, aiming to provide customized refrigerated and frozen food assembly for customers.

The company operates a USDA-inspected facility equipped with high-speed tray sealers, a liquid-nitrogen spiral freezer, a high-speed thermoformer, and clean-in-place production lines. Its capabilities span co-packing of frozen bowls and meals, automated sandwich assembly (including thermoformed wedges, wraps, and subs), modified-atmosphere packaging, and custom recipe development for private-label and branded products such as the GoodSammie line.

Mockingbird serves the airline, food-service, and convenience-store channels, supplying frozen burritos, sandwiches, bowls, and other handheld items to operators in those segments.

The company emphasizes a customer-first model, offering tailored co-packing solutions backed by the Herr Heritage Fund's operational efficiencies, product-development resources, and nationwide logistics network.

name: Moco Shirts
old_description: Moco Shirts has worked with more than 5000 businesses, teams, non profit organizations, churches, and other organizations for custom screen print shirts since 2014. We understand that shopping for custom screen printing online can be an overwhelming task and we are here to help! Whether you have questions about bulk custom t shirts or custom screen printing in nc our knowledgeable staff has the answers.
about:
Moco Shirts was founded in 2014 as a family-owned screen printing and embroidery shop in Union, West Virginia. The business began with a focus on serving local schools, teams, and organizations across the southern part of the state.

Today the company operates two storefronts — its original Union location on Main Street and a second shop in the Red Oaks Shopping Center near Ronceverte — providing in-house screen printing, embroidery, team apparel, and sign and banner production. The shop handles custom designs for everything from jerseys and uniforms to yard signs and aluminum banners, emphasizing consistent quality through internal production.

Its customer base spans schools, businesses, non-profits, churches, and youth leagues throughout Monroe, Greenbrier, Mercer, and neighboring counties. Named school partners include James Monroe, Greenbrier East, Greenbrier West, and Peterstown, while the company also supplies workwear for local businesses and spirit wear for community events in towns such as Lewisburg, Fairlea, and Princeton.

The founders positioned Moco Shirts as a community-rooted operation, promoting a "built here, for here" ethos that stresses personal service and local decision-making rather than national-scale automation.

name: Modular Molding International, Inc., d/b/a A&M Engineering
old_description: MMI specializes in designing and manufacturing plastic injection molds for diverse industries, ranging from automotive clients to manufacturers. Each customer we work with receives the same exceptional service and cost-effective solutions. Our team proudly designs and develops our molds in-house in the U.S. This, along with our deep CAD and SolidWorks expertise, enables us to bring your ideas to life swiftly, economically, and precisely.
about:
Modular Molding International, Inc. (MMI), doing business as A&M Engineering, operates from Largo, Florida. The company was founded in 1991 as a one-person operation and has grown under the leadership of Frank Meola, who has served as president for 26 years and brings over 40 years of plastic injection molding experience.

MMI designs and manufactures plastic injection molds and provides injection molding services. Its in-house design team uses CAD and SolidWorks for 3D modeling, while precision tool building occurs in its own tooling facilities. The company runs a fleet of advanced injection molding machines at its U.S. facilities and also operates a fully-owned production facility in China. Process control relies on eDART system software, and quality inspection employs automated vision systems and robotic arms. MMI follows Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) protocols and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The company serves automotive, consumer products, and general manufacturing customers worldwide. Automotive clients receive PPAP-compliant parts, while the modular molding system patented in 2003 supports flexible prototyping and customization across industries.

MMI emphasizes its commitment to American manufacturing alongside its overseas facility to balance cost savings with quality control. The patented modular molding system, sustainable practices using eDART to reduce waste, and a customer-first philosophy centered on defect-free, on-time delivery form the core of its differentiation.

name: MoldPro, Inc.
old_description: MoldPro, Inc. was founded in 1989 by tool makers. MoldPro continues to be managed by professional tool makers and our first principal and emphasis is on getting the mold right; a correct mold minimizes the impact of molding process variability on part quality.
about:
MoldPro, Inc. was founded in 1989 in Swanzey, New Hampshire, by a group of tool makers. The company remains under the management of professional tool makers, with a founding principle centered on precision mold design to minimize molding process variability.

Operating from a 27,000-square-foot, highly automated plant, MoldPro runs more than 20 computerized injection molding machines with clamping forces from 40 to 300 tons and shot sizes of 0.5 to 20 ounces. The shop provides end-to-end thermoplastic solutions: plastic part design, reverse engineering, tool and mold design and construction, material selection, prototyping, test runs, low-to-high-volume production, decoration, and final assembly including ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, and solvent bonding. An on-site moldmaking shop supports new tool construction and repairs.

MoldPro serves medical device, consumer product, beauty packaging, heavy equipment, and laboratory instrumentation markets. Medical customers source connectors, valve components, syringe parts, resuscitation system components, and laryngoscope blade assemblies. Consumer and industrial clients order firearm components, personal protection device parts, musical instrument accessories, and footwear components. The company also supplies OEM-alternative laboratory plasticware such as digestion vessels, autosampler cups, viscometer vials, and titration beakers for elemental analysis instruments.

The company’s founding principle emphasizes getting the mold right, asserting that a correct mold minimizes the impact of molding process variability on part quality. MoldPro also highlights its “can do” moldmaking reputation, noting it has developed methods to produce parts other firms deemed impossible to injection mold.
